caption: The drawing depicts a clock with a wooden case featuring a pointed, gabled top flanked by two finials. The case appears to be shaded in tones of brown, suggesting a wood texture. The clock face is circular, located in the upper section of the case, and displays Roman numerals, with the time showing approximately 11:59. Below the clock face, in the lower section of the case, there is a rectangular scene showing a colored landscape; this scene includes buildings, trees, and a figure, colored in muted shades of green, yellow, gray, and purple. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there are faint pencil lines around the main composition, indicating its centered placement on the page.
title: Shelf Clock
